relations: A hand grips the upper part of a water bottle suspended above a refrigerator shelf.
The bottle turns about its vertical axis as it descends toward the shelf.
The ribbed base drops until the bottle rests upright beside two stationary bottles.
The fingers loosen and the hand withdraws upward, leaving the small bottle standing.
caption: Inside a refrigerator, two large plastic water bottles with blue labels stand upright on a white shelf at the left, while a hand from the top right holds a smaller bottle suspended above the shelf. The fingers grip the bottle around its upper part, and as it is held the blue label smears and the bottle's orientation shifts in short bursts, indicating it is turning about its vertical axis. The suspended bottle then descends, its ribbed base dropping until the bottle rests upright on the shelf beside the larger ones. Once it stands on its own, the fingers loosen and the hand withdraws upward, leaving only fingertips at the top edge before they recede. Throughout the sequence the two left bottles remain motionless. A faint framing shift changes their placement in the view, suggesting slight camera movement. The hand recedes from the top as the small bottle sits settled.
